objective: Early dynamic anomaly screening and out-of-distribution detection for semiconductor dies at 24h burn-in decision point without future telemetry leakage.

data_governance.synthetic_disclosure: Benchmark results are computed on physics-informed synthetic semiconductor simulation data. Results do not guarantee external real-world silicon qualification until independently validated on physical fab lot telemetry.

train.description: Lots LOT-SYN-001 through LOT-SYN-035 (35 lots, 3500 components). Used exclusively for fitting detector distributions, MAD statistics, ECDFs, and Isolation Forest trees.

validation.description: Lots LOT-SYN-036 through LOT-SYN-042 (7 lots, 700 components). Used strictly for selecting operating decision thresholds under locked optimization policies.

test.description: Lots LOT-SYN-043 through LOT-SYN-050 (8 lots, 800 components). Frozen held-out evaluation partition evaluated exactly once with fixed thresholds.

canonical_features.name: iddq
canonical_features.description: Quiescent supply current at 24h screening point

canonical_features.name: ileak
canonical_features.description: Sub-threshold leakage current at 24h screening point

target_semantics.positive_semantics: Die exhibits abnormal electrical, thermal, or parametric signatures exceeding expected process variations (anomaly_label = 1, e.g. Gate Oxide Short, Timing Offset, Step Breakdown, or early catastrophic failure).
target_semantics.negative_semantics: Nominal or healthy die operating within expected statistical distribution limits (anomaly_label = 0).
target_semantics.semantic_distinction: Instantaneous anomaly detection at 24h is strictly distinguished from longitudinal parametric drift (GPR) and latent 168h failure wear-out (XGBoost trajectory prediction).

candidates.name: conservative_fusion
candidates.description: Alarm raised if any individual detector (MAD, COPOD, or Isolation Forest) exceeds its operating reject threshold.

candidates.name: weighted_score_fusion
candidates.description: Normalized linear combination of calibrated detector scores: w_mad * norm(s_mad) + w_copod * norm(s_copod) + w_iso * norm(s_iso).
